Base directory for this skill: /Users/otischen/Developer/hozu-trial-0024/hozu-cold-sonnet/app/.claude/skills/hozu

# Hozu

Hozu is not in your training data: this file and `npx hozu docs <topic>` are the whole API (skip
`node_modules/@hozu`). Diagnostics teach the other rules when you break them: apply their fix.

## The change loop
1. `npx hozu map`: the session shape, the verify line, every file's role, each declaration's `file:line`. Open
   only the lines the change touches. A new app: `npx hozu add feature <name> --page / --with …`, then
   `npx hozu docs feature`.
2. Edit everything the change needs (table below).
3. `npx hozu check` once. For an intended behaviour change, `npx hozu check --update-lock`, then list the accepted
   `now:` lines in your summary.
4. Verify once with the line `hozu map` prints: `npx hozu browse <path> --session '…' --js both --do '…'`. It runs
   the same app as `npm start`, with and without JS; do not start a server or use `curl`.

## What to touch
| Change | Touch |
|---|---|
| UI-only state (a tab) | model: a context field, an event, an `on` whose `assign` sets it → views: the control |
| Filter / sort in the URL | the route's `search` (with a default) → `ui.link(route, params, { key })` → `search.key`; filtering while typing: `seed: ({ search }) => ({ key: search.key })`, read `ctx.key` |
| A per-item action stored on the server (pin, archive) | model: the item field, an event, a mutation that `invalidates` the list tag, `on(E, { target: 'pinning', assign: (e) => { ctx.target = e.id } })`, a state with `invoke` → views: the per-item form (`hozu docs patterns`) → app: store it, sort in the list resolver |
| A control every state handles | `machine({ on: [...] })` |
| New page | `routes.ts` → a view with `route` → `ui.page(...)` in `hozu.config.ts` |
| UI (a button, a field) | `ui.use` of a kit component; the catalog: `npx hozu docs components` |

## Rules no diagnostic checks
- **Every query and mutation states `runs`:** a database, a secret or the session → `'server'` (resolver in
  `app.ts`); the visitor's browser credentials → `'browser'`; a public API → `'either'`, implemented in the feature's
  `fetch.ts` (`npx hozu docs fetch`).
- **Query resolvers only read.** Writes belong in mutation and endpoint resolvers; a prefetched link runs queries.
- **Other users, reloads, sign-out:** verify them in one `browse` chain with `--js both` (`--as <name>` per user).
- **Contracts only where a transition decides:** a guard, a `navigate`, a `fn` or computed value. Copy-only
  transitions are reviewed in the lock.
- **`'live'` only for push** to pages that are already open.
- **`invalidates` drives the client refresh** of every query with those tags, whatever its freshness.

## Topics (`npx hozu docs <topic>`; `--more`: options, edge cases)
| Task | Topic |
|---|---|
| a new feature, the files, a complete example | `feature` |
| elements, attributes, events, lists, links, reuse | `views` |
| states, events, invoke, timers, guards | `machine` |
| queries, mutations, tags, `fn()`, resolvers | `data` |
| where effects run, `fetch.ts`, browser tokens, static hosts | `fetch` |
| contracts and the lock | `contracts` |
| routes, search, pages, `head`, 403 / 404 | `pages` |
| forms, checkboxes, bulk forms, no JS | `forms` |
| sign-in, sessions, per-user data | `auth` |
| filters, modes, per-item actions, load more | `patterns` |
| worked changes | `recipes` |
| webhooks, JSON APIs, redirects | `endpoints` |
| components, kits, browser APIs, DOM libraries | `components` |
| languages, env, HTTP, Markdown, tests, deploying, upgrading Hozu | `i18n` `env` `http` `content` `testing` `deploy` |
| a diagnostic code | `diagnostics` |
| change requests from Hozu DevTools (`.hozu/requests`) | `requests` |

# Languages

- **The URL holds the language:** `site: { lang: 'en', locales: ['en', 'de'], … }` keeps `/posts/a` for `en` and
  prefixes the others (`/de/posts/a`). Routes and `ui.link` stay locale-free. No cookie, session field or rewrite.
- Switch: `ui.a({ href: ui.alternate('de') }, ['Deutsch'])`.
- `export const text = ui.messages('en', { en: { saved: '{count} saved' }, de: { saved: '{count} gespeichert' } })`
  in a listed module; `text.saved({ count })` in views. Every locale needs every key (HZ040).
- Machines never hold translated text (HZ041): store a code.

More (options, edge cases): hozu docs i18n --more

# Languages

- **The URL holds the language:** `site: { lang: 'en', locales: ['en', 'de'], … }` keeps `/posts/a` for `en` and
  prefixes the others (`/de/posts/a`). Routes and `ui.link` stay locale-free. No cookie, session field or rewrite.
- Switch: `ui.a({ href: ui.alternate('de') }, ['Deutsch'])`.
- `export const text = ui.messages('en', { en: { saved: '{count} saved' }, de: { saved: '{count} gespeichert' } })`
  in a listed module; `text.saved({ count })` in views. Every locale needs every key (HZ040).
- Machines never hold translated text (HZ041): store a code.

## Details
- Reload, sign-in and sign-out keep the language, because every link and `navigate` resolves `ui.link` in the
  page's locale.
- `/en/posts/a` answers 308 `/posts/a`. There is no `Accept-Language` redirect: a new visit to an unprefixed URL
  shows `site.lang`. Contracts expect the default URLs. `<html lang>`, hreflang and the sitemap are derived. A page
  route starting with a locale segment is HZ060.
- A toggle: `locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en')`.
- Messages: use `text.title` or `text.saved({ count })` in views and `head.render`; every locale needs the same
  `{placeholders}` (HZ040). Plurals: `'{n, plural, =0 {none} one {# item} other {# items}}'`.
- Machines store a code and the view chooses the message.
- `ui.format.number(x, { style: 'currency', currency: 'EUR' })`, `ui.format.date(x, { dateStyle: 'medium' })`,
  `ui.format.relative(n, 'day')`, `ui.format.list(xs)`. `locale` is in every view.

import { contract, part, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { admin, archive, deleteAccount, home, notePage } from '../../routes.ts'
import { me } from '../account/model.ts'
import {
  Add,
  adminUsers,
  Archive,
  archiveNotes,
  Bulk,
  removeNotes,
  Select,
  lastDeleted,
  listArchived,
  noteDetail,
  noteNumberParam,
  Restore,
  Cancel,
  Edit,
  EditDraft,
  addedOn,
  Draft,
  listNotes,
  listedNotes,
  hasMore,
  selectedCount,
  PAGE_SIZE,
  noMatch,
  isAdminName,
  notesMachine,
  Pin,
  Remove,
  Save,
  SaveDetail,
  exportNotes,
  Search,
  Share,
  sharedNotes,
  ToggleAccess,
  Undo,
  Unshare,
  visibleNotes,
} from './model.ts'
import { text } from './text.ts'

const bulk = ui.formRef()

const errorText = part((code: string) =>
  code === 'duplicate' ? text.duplicate
    : code === 'notFound' ? text.notFound
    : code === 'archived' ? text.archived
    : code === 'tooMany' ? text.tooMany
    : code === 'nothingToUndo' ? text.nothingToUndo
    : code === 'selfShare' ? text.selfShare
    : code === 'readOnly' ? text.readOnly
    : code,
)

const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: home,
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ search: search.q }),
  render: ({ ctx, when, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [text.notes]),
      ui.query(
        me,
        {},
        {
          ready: (user) => (user.readOnly ? ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [text.readOnlyAccount]) : null),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.p({ class: 'flex gap-4 text-sm' }, [
        ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'underline' }, [text.language]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(archive, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.archivedNotes]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(deleteAccount, null), class: 'underline' }, [text.deleteAccount]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, { format: 'json' }), class: 'underline' }, [text.export]),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, { format: 'csv' }), class: 'underline' }, [text.exportCsv]),
      ]),
      ui.form({ class: 'flex gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Add, { title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
        ui.label({ for: 'notes-title', class: 'sr-only' }, [text.title]),
        ui.input({
          id: 'notes-title',
          name: 'title',
          required: true,
          minlength: 1,
          maxlength: 60,
          value: ctx.draft,
          'aria-invalid': ctx.fields.title !== null,
          'aria-describedby': 'notes-title-error',
          class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
          on: { input: ui.send(Draft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
        }),
        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded bg-indigo-600 px-4 py-2 text-white disabled:opacity-50' }, [text.add]),
      ]),
      ui.p({ id: 'notes-title-error', role: 'alert', class: 'text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.fields.title]),
      ctx.error !== null && ui.p({ role: 'alert', class: 'text-rose-600' }, [errorText(ctx.error)]),
      ui.query(
        lastDeleted,
        {},
        {
          ready: (deleted) =>
            deleted === null
              ? null
              : ui.div({ role: 'status', class: 'flex items-center gap-3 rounded border bg-slate-50 px-4 py-2 text-sm' }, [
                  ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [
                    deleted.count === 1
                      ? ui.span({}, ['Deleted "', deleted.title, '"'])
                      : ui.span({}, ['Deleted ', deleted.count, ' notes']),
                  ]),
                  ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Undo, {}) } }, [
                    ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'underline' }, [text.undo]),
                  ]),
                ]),
          pending: null,
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.query(
        listNotes,
        {},
        {
          ready: (all) => ui.div({ class: 'space-y-3' }, [
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [text.count({ count: all.length })]),
            ui.form({ method: 'get', role: 'search', class: 'flex gap-2' }, [
              ui.input({
                id: 'notes-search',
                type: 'search',
                name: 'q',
                'aria-label': text.search,
                value: ctx.search,
                class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-3 py-2',
                on: { input: ui.send(Search, { text: ui.dom.value }) },
              }),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'rounded border px-4 py-2' }, [text.search]),
            ]),
            ui.p({ class: 'text-sm text-slate-600' }, [
              'Showing ',
              listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }).length,
              ' of ',
              selectedCount({ items: all, text: search.q }),
            ]),
            ui.form({ ref: bulk, class: 'flex items-center gap-3 text-sm', on: { submit: ui.send(Bulk, { ids: ui.dom.formAll('ids'), action: ui.dom.form('action') }) } }, [
              ui.span({ class: 'flex-1 text-slate-600' }, ['Selected: ', ctx.selected.length]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'archive', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.archiveSelected]),
              ui.button({ type: 'submit', name: 'action', value: 'delete', class: 'rounded border px-3 py-1' }, [text.deleteSelected]),
            ]),
            noMatch({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search })
              ? ui.div({}, [
                  when(['adding'], [ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [pendingNote(ctx.draft)])]),
                  when(['idle', 'saving', 'removing', 'pinning', 'archiving', 'undoing', 'restoring', 'sharing', 'unsharing'], [
                    ui.p({ class: 'text-slate-500' }, [text.noMatch]),
                  ]),
                ])
              : ui.ul({ class: 'divide-y rounded border bg-white' }, [
                  when(['adding'], [pendingNote(ctx.draft)]),
                  ui.each(visibleNotes({ items: listedNotes({ items: all, text: search.q, limit: search.limit }), text: ctx.search }), 'id', (item) =>
                    ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3' }, [
                      ui.input({
                        type: 'checkbox',
                        form: bulk,
                        name: 'ids',
                        value: item.id,
                        'aria-label': `Select ${item.title}`,
                        checked: ctx.selected.includes(item.id),
                        disabled: ctx.busy,
                        on: { change: ui.send(Select, { id: item.id, checked: ui.dom.checked }) },
                      }),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['No. ', item.number]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'flex flex-1 flex-wrap gap-2', on: { submit: ui.send(Save, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({
                              name: 'title',
                              'aria-label': 'Edit title',
                              required: true,
                              minlength: 1,
                              maxlength: 60,
                              value: ctx.editTitle,
                              'aria-invalid': ctx.editError !== null,
                              'aria-describedby': 'notes-edit-error',
                              class: 'flex-1 rounded border px-2 py-1',
                              on: { input: ui.send(EditDraft, { title: ui.dom.value }) },
                            }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.save]),
                            ui.p({ id: 'notes-edit-error', class: 'w-full text-sm text-rose-600' }, [ctx.editError]),
                          ])
                        : ui.a({ href: ui.link(notePage, noteNumberParam({ number: item.number })), class: 'flex-1 underline' }, [item.title]),
                      ctx.editing === item.id
                        ? ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Cancel, {}) } }, [
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.cancel]),
                          ])
                        : ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Edit, { id: ui.dom.form('id'), title: ui.dom.form('title') }) } }, [
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                            ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'title', value: item.title }),
                            ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.edit]),
                          ]),
                      ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, [
                        'Added ',
                        ui.time({ datetime: item.createdAt }, [addedOn({ at: item.createdAt })]),
                      ]),
                      item.pinned && ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-amber-700' }, ['pinned']),
                      ui.form({ class: 'inline', on: { submit: ui.send(Pin, { id: ui.dom.form('id') }) } }, [
                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [item.pinned ? text.unpin : text.pin]),

                        ui.input({ type: 'hidden', name: 'id', value: item.id }),
                        ui.button({ type: 'submit', class: 'text-sm underline' }, [text.archive]),
